Business Questions & Strategic Answers.1. What drives profit?: Order profitability is primarily governed by Effective Sales volume (net ticket size after discounts) and product Category margin structure. Furniture orders inherently yield significantly higher absolute and percentage margins (~16.2%), whereas Fashion and Electronics operate on razor-thin baseline margins (~2.8%-3.5%).
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.2. How important is discounting?: Discounting is the single largest margin destroyer. Monetary discount amount (Discount_Amount) and discount percentage (Discount_pct) directly subtract from top-line contribution. Beyond 20% discount, profitability collapses by more than 60% across all categories.
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.3. How important is delivery delay?: While delivery delays do not directly alter the booked unit margin at checkout, delivery delays indirectly crush net realized profit because orders delayed past 5 days suffer double the return rate (41.2%), generating reverse logistics overhead and zero net revenue.
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.4. Which categories contribute most to p: Furniture is NovaCart's most lucrative category, generating an average 16.2% profit margin. Home Appliances ranks second at 7.8% margin. Conversely, Fashion (2.9% margin) and Electronics (3.5% margin) experience severe margin compression.
Business Questions & Strategic Answers.5. Which regions contribute most to prof: North and West regions lead profitability with average margins of ~8.9%. In contrast, the South region generates high gross sales volume but suffers the lowest profit margins (4.76%) due to elevated promotional discounting and fulfillment costs.
